summary.text: Jennifer Boylan is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 66 since January 3, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as operations director.

paragraphs.text: Boylan grew up in New York and lives in Barrington, Rhode Island.
She earned a B.A. in geology and earth science from Franklin & Marshall College in 1987 and an M.A. in earth and planetary science from Washington University in St. Louis in 1989.
Boylan's career experience includes work as an environmental consultant at Swidler Berlin and The Brattle Group and as a director of operations at PacketLogix.
Governor Gina Raimondo appointed her to the Working Group for Gun Safety.
